rule: A workflow targeting a Forma version earlier than a capability's 'since' version, or requiring a capability this list does not contain, is valid format using unavailable Forma capabilities.

workflow.core.description: Nodes, edges, labels, kinds, descriptions and the accessible relationship list.

workflow.shapes.description: Node variants rectangle, rounded, pill, ellipse and diamond (diagram contract 2.0.0).

workflow.color.description: Authored fill, stroke, accent, foreground and connector stroke as tokens or literals.

workflow.palette.description: Named palette slots referenced as palette:<slot>.

workflow.groups.description: Groups and containers with explicit membership.

workflow.ports.description: Named connection points on node sides (diagram contract 2.1.0).

workflow.status.description: Semantic status shown as text on nodes, edges and groups (diagram contract 2.1.0).

workflow.references.description: Typed domain references displayed as text or links.

workflow.interactions.description: Declarative interaction intents reported to the host.

workflow.legend.description: A key explaining authored colour and line meaning.

workflow.layout.description: Authored geometry, waypoints and the deterministic default layout.
